card.name: Connecting words before a follow-up clause
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas in explanatory prose, where the next words begin a comment, consequence or conclusion. Examples are 'again,', 'this means', 'leads to', and 'given the above information,'.

modes.label: Comma after framing phrase
modes.description: A comma following an introductory phrase, just before the main point.
modes.example: So, again<<,>> why might he paint this in 1

modes.label: Link to a consequence or comment
modes.description: A verb, determiner or preposition that leads into a result or evaluation.
modes.example: But of course this<< means>> every machine must use an ID that is

modes.label: Reference or quantifier word
modes.description: A word like 'such', 'above' or 'as' that points to a category or earlier text.
modes.example: it holds tremendous promise for<< such>> areas as electric vehicles as well as many
